description: CHECK TOPOLOGY TEXT BEFORE DRAWING IT: reads the same source `create_diagram` would and reports what it found — the format it detected, how many devices and links it would draw, and every line it would skip or adjust, with the line number and the reason. An unknown `kind=` names the nearest real one. Nothing is laid out, routed or rendered, so it is far cheaper than a draw: call it, fix what it names, then call `create_diagram` once. Results carry `name`: a suggested basename for this diagram. Write every file for one diagram into its own directory named after it — <name>/<name>.drawio, <name>/<name>.svg, <name>/<name>.cables.csv — so two diagrams never share a directory.

source.description: Topology text: Graphviz DOT, Mermaid, CSV, CDP/LLDP neighbour output from most switch vendors, a FortiLink topology dump, Containerlab, Meraki or UniFi JSON, or an Ansible inventory. Device output goes in exactly as the user pasted it — do not rewrite it as DOT.

name: validate
